sn35.87:1.1: Ekaṃ samayaṃ Bhagavā Rājagahe viharati Veḷuvane Kalandakanivāpe || || 2
sn35.87:1.2: Tena kho pana samayena āyasmā ca Sāriputto āyasmā ca Mahā-Cundo āyasmā ca Channo Gijjhakūṭe pabbate viharanti || || 3
sn35.87:1.3: Tena kho pana samayena āyasmā Channo ābādhiko hoti dukkhito bāḷhagilāno || || 4
sn35.87:1.4: Atha kho āyasmā Sāriputto sāyaṇhasamayam paṭisallānā vuṭṭhito yenāyasmā Mahā-Cundo tenupasaṅkami || upasaṅkamitvā āyasmantam Mahā-Cundam etad avoca || ||
sn35.87:1.5: Āyāmāvuso Cunda yenāyasmā Channo tenupasaṅkamissāma gilānapucchakā ti || ||
sn35.87:1.6: Evam āvuso ti kho āyasmā Mahā-Cundo āyasmato Sāriputtassa paccassosi || || 5
sn35.87:2.1: Atha kho āyasmā ca Sāriputto āyasmā ca Mahā-Cundo yenāyasmā Channo tenupasaṅkamiṃsu || upasaṅkamitvā paññatte āsane nisīdiṃsu || || 6 Nisajja kho āyasmā Sāriputto āyasmantaṃ Channam etad avoca || ||
sn35.87:2.2: Kacci te āvuso Channa khamanīyaṃ kacci yāpanīyaṃ kacci dukkhā vedanā paṭikkamanti no abhikkamanti || patikkamo sānam paññāyati no abhikkamo ti || || 7
sn35.87:3.1: Na me āvuso Sāriputta khamanīyaṃ na yāpanīyaṃ || bāḷhā me dukkhā vedanā abhikkamanti no paṭikkamanti || abhikkhamo sānam paññāyati no paṭikkamo ti || || 8
sn35.87:3.2: Seyyathāpi āvuso balavā puriso tiṇhena sikharena muddhānam abhimattheyya || evam eva kho āvuso adhimattā vātā muddhānam upahananti || ||
sn35.87:3.3: Na me āvuso khamanīyaṃ na yāpanīyam || pe || no paṭikkamo ti || || 9
sn35.87:3.4: Seyyathāpi āvuso balavā puriso daḷhena varattakhaṇḍena sīse sīsaveṭhaṃ dadeyya || evam eva kho āvuso adhimattā me sīse vedanā || ||
sn35.87:3.5: Na me āvuso khamanīyaṃ na yāpanīyaṃ || pe || no patikkamo ti || || 10
sn35.87:3.6: Seyyathāpi āvuso dakkho goghātako vā goghātakantevāsī vā tiṇhena govikantanena kucchiṃ parikanteyya || evam eva kho me āvuso adhimattā vātā kucchim parikantanti || ||
sn35.87:3.7: Na me āvuso khamanīyaṃ || pe || no paṭikkamo ti || || 11
sn35.87:3.8: Seyyathāpi avuso dve balavanto purisā dubbalataram purisaṃ nānābāhāsu gāhetvā aṅgārakāsuyā santāpeyyuṃ samparitāpeyyuṃ || evam eva kho me āvuso adhimatto kāyasmiṃ dāho || ||
sn35.87:3.9: Na me āvuso khamanīyaṃ na yāpanīyaṃ || bāḷhā me dukkhā vedanā abhikkamanti na paṭikkamanti || abhikkamo sānam paññāyati no paṭikkamo ti || || 12
sn35.87:3.10: Sattham āvuso Sāriputta āharissāmi nāvakaṅkhāmi jīvitunti || || 13
sn35.87:4.2: yāpetāyasmā Channo yāpentam mayam āyasmantaṃ Channaṃ icchāma || ||
sn35.87:4.3: Sace āyasmato Channassa natthi sappāyāni bhojanāni || aham āyasmato Channassa sappāyāni bhojanāni pariyesissāmi || ||
sn35.87:4.4: Sace āyasmato Channassa natthi sappāyāni bhesajjāni || aham āyasmato Channassa sappāyāni bhesajjāni pariyesissāmi || ||
sn35.87:4.5: Sace āyasmato Channassa natthi patirūpā upaṭṭhākā || aham āyasmantaṃ Channam upaṭṭhahissāmi || ||
sn35.87:4.7: yāpetāyasmā Channo yāpentam mayam āyasmantaṃ Channam icchāmā ti || || 14
sn35.87:5.1: Na me āvuso Sāriputta natthi sappāyāni bhojananāni
sn35.87:5.3: na pi me natthi sappāyāni bhesajjāni
sn35.87:5.5: na pi me natthi patirūpā upaṭṭhākā
sn35.87:5.7: Api ca me āvuso satthā pariciṇṇo dīgharattaṃ manāpeneva no amanāpena ||
sn35.87:5.8: etaṃ hi āvuso sāvakassa patirūpaṃ || || Yam satthāram paricareyya manāpeneva no amanāpena tam
sn35.87:5.9: anupavajjam Channo bhikkhu sattham āharissatīti evam etam āvuso Sāriputta dhārehī ti || || 15
sn35.87:6.1: Puccheyyāma mayam āyasmantam Channam kiñcid eva desaṃ sace āyasmā Channo okāsam karoti pañhassa veyyākaraṇāyā ti || ||
sn35.87:7.1: Cakkhum āvuso Channa cakkhuviññāṇaṃ cakkhuviññāṇaviññātabbe dhamme Etam mama eso ham asmi eso me attāti samanupassasi || Sotam || Ghānam || ||
sn35.87:7.2: Jivham āvuso Channa jivhāviññāṇaṃ jivhāviññāṇaviññātabbe dhamme Etam mama eso ham asmi eso me attāti samanupassasi || Kāyam ||
sn35.87:7.3: Manam āvuso Channa manoviññāṇam manoviññāṇaviññātabbe dhamme Etam mama eso ham asmi eso me attāti samanupassasīti || || 17
sn35.87:8.1: Cakkhum āvuso Sāriputta cakkhuviññāṇaṃ cakkhuviññāṇaviññātabbe dhamme Netam mama neso ham asmi na meso attāti samanupassāmi || Sotam || Ghānam ||
sn35.87:8.2: Jivham āvuso Sāriputta jivhāviññāṇam jivhāviññāṇa viññātabbe dhamme Netam mama neso ham asmi na meso attāti samanupassāmi || Kāyam ||
sn35.87:8.3: Manam āvuso Sāriputta manoviññāṇam manoviññāṇaviññātabbe dhamme Netam mama neso ham asmi na meso attāti samanupassāmī ti || || 18
sn35.87:9.1: Cakkhusmim āvuso Channa cakkhuviññāṇe cakkhuviññāṇaviññātabbesu dhammesu kiṃ disvā kim abhiññāya cakkhuṃ cakkhuviññāṇaṃ cakkhuviññāṇaviññātabbedhamme Netam mama neso ham asmi na meso attāti samanupassasi || Sotasmim || Ghānasmim ||
sn35.87:9.2: Jivhāya āvuso Channa jivhaviññāṇaviññātabbesu dhammesu kiṃ disvā kim abhiññāya jivhaṃ jivhāviññāṇaṃ jivhāviññātabbe dhamme Netam mama neso ham asmi na meso attāti samanupassasi || Kāyasmim āvuso ||
sn35.87:9.3: Manasmim āvuso Channa manoviññāṇe manoviññāṇaviññātabbesu dhammesu kiṃ disvā kim abhiññāya manam manoviññāṇe manoviññāṇaviññātabbe dhamme Netam mama neso ham asmi nameso attāti samanupassasī ti || || 19
sn35.87:10.1: Cakkhusmim āvuso Sāriputta cakkhuviññāṇe cakkhuviññāṇaviññātabbesu dhammesu nirodham disvā nirodham abhiññāya cakkhu cakkhuviññāṇam cakkhuviññāṇaviññātabbe dhamme Netam mama neso ham asmi na meso attāti samanupassāmi || Sotasmiṃ || Ghānasmiṃ ||
sn35.87:10.2: Jivhāya āvuso Sāriputta jivhāviññāṇe jivhāviññāṇaṃ jivhāviññāṇaviññātabbe dhamme Netam mama neso ham asmi na meso attāti samanupassāmi || Kāyasmim ||
sn35.87:10.3: Manasmim āvuso Sāriputta manoviññāṇe manoviññāṇaviññātabbesu dhammesu nirodhaṃ disvā nirodham abhiññāya manam manoviññāṇam manoviññāṇaviññātabbe dhamme Netam mama neso ham asmi na meso attāti samanupassāmīti || || 20
sn35.87:11.1: Evaṃ vutte āyasmā Mahā-Cundo āyasmantaṃ Channam etad avoca || ||
sn35.87:11.2: Tasmā ti ha āvuso Channa idam pi tassa Bhagavato sāsanam niccakappaṃ sādhukam manasi kātabbaṃ || ||
sn35.87:11.8: cutupapāte asati nevidha na huraṃ na ubhayam antarena
sn35.87:12.1: Atha kho āyasmā ca Sāriputto āyasmā ca Mahā-Cundo āyasmantaṃ Channam iminā ovādena ovāditvā uṭṭhāyasanā pakkamiṃsu || || 22
sn35.87:12.2: Atha kho āyasmā Channo acirapakkantesu tesu āyasmantesu sattham āharesi || || 23
sn35.87:13.1: Atha kho āyasmā Sāriputto yena Bhagavā tenupasaṅkami || upasaṅkamitvā Bhagavantam abhivādetvā ekam antaṃ nisīdi || || 24 Ekam antaṃ nisinno kho āyasmā Sāriputto Bhagavantam etad avoca || ||
sn35.87:13.3: tassa kā gati ko abhisamparāyo ti || ||
sn35.87:13.4: Nanu te Sāriputta Channena bhikkhunā sammukhā yeva anupavajjatā vyākatā ti || || 25
sn35.87:13.7: Honti hete Sāriputta Channassa bhikkhuno mittakulāni suhajjakulāni upavajjakulāni ||
sn35.87:13.8: na kho panāham Sāriputta ettāvatā Sa-upavajjo ti vadāmi || ||
sn35.87:13.9: Yo kho Sāriputta tañ ca kāyaṃ nikkhipati aññañca kāyam upādiyati || tam ahaṃ Sa-upavajjo ti vadāmi ||
